topic: 近一年空间数据生产难点及具身机器人与智能驾驶数据难点异同

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): The static embodied-AI taxonomy lacks autonomous-driving spatial-data production, so this expansion creates balanced robot and driving evidence surfaces.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robot-spatial-data-4d
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"robot manipulation" OR all:"embodied AI") AND (all:"4D data" OR all:"3D point tracks" OR all:"spatiotemporal data")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find papers that make geometry and temporal correspondence explicit in robot data.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robot-spatial-calibration
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:robot AND (all:"hand-eye calibration" OR all:"sensor calibration" OR all:"time synchronization") AND (all:dataset OR all:demonstration)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover coordinate-frame and synchronization failures during robot dataset production.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robot-occlusion-contact-data
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"robot manipulation" AND (all:occlusion OR all:contact OR all:deformable) AND (all:dataset OR all:data OR all:demonstration)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover spatial state that vision cannot directly observe during contact-rich manipulation.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robot-auto-annotation-3d
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:robot AND (all:"automatic annotation" OR all:"pseudo label" OR all:"data engine") AND (all:3D OR all:spatial)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find scalable robot spatial labeling and its error modes.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-driving-spatial-data-core
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"autonomous driving" OR all:"self-driving") AND (all:"spatial data" OR all:"3D data" OR all:"4D data") AND (all:dataset OR all:annotation OR all:generation)

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-driving-occupancy-data
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"autonomous driving" AND (all:"3D occupancy" OR all:"4D occupancy" OR all:"occupancy flow") AND (all:dataset OR all:label OR all:benchmark)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Occupancy is a major spatial representation whose ground truth is difficult to produce under occlusion.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-driving-hd-map-production
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"autonomous driving" AND (all:"HD map" OR all:"online mapping" OR all:"map update") AND (all:dataset OR all:annotation OR all:construction)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover map creation, freshness, localization, and update costs.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-driving-calibration-sync
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"autonomous driving" AND (all:"sensor calibration" OR all:"time synchronization" OR all:"multi-sensor dataset")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover fleet-scale multi-sensor alignment and drift.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-driving-auto-labeling
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"autonomous driving" AND (all:"automatic annotation" OR all:"auto-labeling" OR all:"pseudo label") AND (all:3D OR all:LiDAR OR all:occupancy)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover scalable 3D labeling and teacher/model bias.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-driving-long-tail-mining
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"autonomous driving" AND (all:"long tail" OR all:"rare scenario" OR all:"corner case") AND (all:dataset OR all:"data mining")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover event rarity and log-selection difficulty rather than average road coverage.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-driving-generative-simulation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"autonomous driving" AND (all:"world model" OR all:"generative simulation" OR all:"synthetic data") AND (all:evaluation OR all:closed-loop OR all:sim2real)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover generated spatial data, controllability, realism, and closed-loop validity.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-driving-adverse-weather-data
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"autonomous driving" AND (all:"adverse weather" OR all:night OR all:"sensor degradation") AND (all:dataset OR all:data)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover environmental domain gaps and sensor failure regimes.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-cross-domain-spatial-ground-truth
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:robotics OR all:"autonomous driving") AND (all:"spatial ground truth" OR all:"ground truth quality" OR all:"label uncertainty")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find methods and critiques about imperfect spatial ground truth across both domains.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-driving-spatial-data-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org autonomous driving spatial data production occupancy auto labeling dataset 2025 2026
dynamic_suggestions.why: Fallback discovery for driving papers under vocabulary missed by API queries.
